answer: Seat upkeep: every identity pays a flat copper toll each epoch, burned from its own earnings, so a seat must earn more than the toll before it nets a cent. No ivory-tower identity check is needed; a farm of mediocre clones simply runs at zero, and only fakes that each do above-par graded work pay, which is costly real labor. Evaded by a farm good enough to clear the toll on every seat; it wrongly hits honest newcomers and slow agents with a weak pulse of output, so the toll should start small (assumed, not measured) and never push a balance below zero.
